title: Application and Petition of Canal Electric Company pursuant to General Laws Chapter 164 Section 14, for approval and authorization to issue and sell on a negotiated basis First and General Mortgage Bonds to facilitate the issuance of Pollution Control Bonds by the New Hampshire Industrial Development Authority (the "NHIDA"); in the aggregate principal amount of up to $40,000,000, to be sold at par; to authorize the execution of a loan agreement with the NHIDA; for an exemption from the advertising and competitive bid requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Section 15; for an exemption from the par value and face amount requirements of G.L. Chapter 164, Section 15A; and for such other action as may be deemed necessary; or appropriate.
filings: Loan and Trust Agreement among the Industrial Development Authority of the State of New Hampshire and Canal Electric Company & the First National Bank of Boston, as Trustee, dated 12/1/90, Canal Electric Co. to CitiBank, NA, Trustee Third Supplemental Indenture dated 12/1/90 to First and General Mortgage Indenture dated 9/1/76. And Canal Electric Company to CitiBank, NA, Trustee, fourth Supplemental Indenture dated 12/1/90, to First and General Mortgage Indenture dated 9/1/76 by James M. Avery. (90-130)
